parts.gloss: she of the beautiful forehead (the wife)

words.gloss: she of the beautiful forehead (the wife)

literal: Friends' need they will not fulfill; good deeds they will not perform; she of the beautiful forehead's desire accordingly those who conduct themselves.
translation: Those who live only to please the desires of their beautiful-browed wives will neither relieve the needs of their friends nor perform any virtuous deeds.
modern: அழகிய நெற்றியை உடைய மனைவியின் விருப்பப்படி நடப்பவர்கள், தம் நண்பர்களின் தேவைகளை நிறைவேற்ற மாட்டார்கள்; அறச் செயல்களையும் செய்ய மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet warns against losing one's independence by becoming entirely subservient to a spouse's whims. The phrase 'நன்னுதலாள்' refers to a wife with a beautiful forehead, and 'பெட்டாங்கு ஒழுகுபவர்' describes a husband who acts solely to satisfy her desires. Such submissiveness isolates a person from their wider social duties. Consequently, they fail to help their friends in times of need ('நட்டார் குறைமுடியார்') and neglect their moral obligation to perform virtuous deeds ('நன்றாற்றார்') for society.
